title: vaccinium uliginosum subsp. nanum
intro: Vaccinium uliginosum subsp. nanum, commonly known as the small bilberry or dwarf bilberry, is a sub-species of the bilberry plant that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium uliginosum subsp. nanum include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
